name: HoloINR
aliases: Implicit Neural Representation for Near-Field Holotomography
definition: HoloINR solves the coupled inverse problem of holotomography (holography and tomography) using Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) for near-field setups where Fresnel propagation models the physics between object and detector.
summary: HoloINR reconstructs volumes by combining holographic phase retrieval with tomography using continuous neural fields, explicitly modeling near-field Fresnel propagation instead of far-field assumptions.
